name: Lampad
body:
Lampads and avernales can sometimes mix their blood with that of other worthy underground dwellers or travelers.

Player characters with lampad blood in their veins can select the following alternate racial trait.

Saddening Tears

Members of an underground or earth-related race who descend from a lampad gain the following supernatural ability:

Once per hour as a standard action, such a character can cry saddening tears. Any creature not of its subtype (if humanoid) or type (if a native outsider) must make a successful Will saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 the user’s character level + the user’s Charisma modifier) or become shaken for 1d4 rounds. A target that successfully saves cannot be affected by the user’s saddening tears for 24 hours. Creatures that are already shaken cannot become frightened or panicked. This is a sonic, mind-affecting effect.

A dwarf can take this trait in place of greed and hatred. An oread can take this trait in place of spell-like ability and earth affinity. A naiad can take this trait in place of water bond. A svirfneblin can take it in place of gnome magic. A human can take it in place of skilled. A human who replaces skilled with saddening tears also gains darkvision 60 ft.
